summary.text: Norman Crow is a Republican state representative from Alabama House District 63 who won a January 13, 2026 special election and is seeking a full term in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Judith Taylor is also on the ballot. A certified public accountant, Crow is president of a local trucking company.

paragraphs.text: Crow earned his bachelor's degree from the University of Alabama and became a certified public accountant in 1994.
In 2004 he became president of a local trucking company, D.T. & Freight Company.
Ballotpedia states that Crow and his wife, Keeshan, have three children who attend Tuscaloosa City Schools.
Crow won the special general election for District 63 on January 13, 2026, and assumed office on January 14, 2026.
